remarks_1999: Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks indicate, "Note: Picture bought from O'Keeffe." Whitney Archive notes backing inscription. Not recorded Downtown Gallery Archive. Letter from O'Keeffe to first owner indicates painted at Lake George. (Source: Lynes, 1999)
